title: Condition completeness
research_question: Which conditions are available and included in the paired cohort?
filters: all matrix rows and initial frame-condition slots; attempts including retries counted separately
main_observation: 0 frames are retained in every condition. Generated/approved/rejected counts deduplicate retries; rejected means no approved attempt for that slot.
allowed_interpretation: Availability and attempts are separate quantities; attempt_count and retry_count are exported separately. C0 has no generated slots.
forbidden_interpretation: A missing condition is never a zero detector score.
